tool.name: convert_usd_to_inr
tool.title: USD → INR calculator (live rates)
tool.description: Returns the current live USD→INR mid-market rate from Xflowpay, with XE as a supplementary reference rate. Only USD→INR is supported. Provides today's current rate only — not historical or prior-day data. If no Xflowpay rate data is available, returns no data. Optional amount_usd calculates the INR equivalent at the live Xflow rate.

amount_usd.description: USD amount to pre-fill in the calculator (optional; user can also enter it directly in the widget)

toCurrency.description: Target currency ISO code (default: INR; only INR supported)

fromCurrency.description: Source currency ISO code (default: USD; only USD supported)

_published_faq.name: How do I add xflowpay-mcp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add xflowpay-mcp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.xflowpay.com/mcp/claude.

_published_faq.name: Is xflowpay-mcp MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, xflowpay-mcp scores 93/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is xflowpay-mcp's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, xflowpay-mcp scores 92/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 4 of 4 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the xflowpay-mcp MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: xflowpay-mcp provides these MCP tools: convert_usd_to_inr, fx_forecast, fx_historical_rates, and fx_live_rate.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to xflowpay-mcp?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to xflowpay-mcp in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
xflowpay-mcp does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
xflowpay-mcp is developed by Xflow Payments India Private Limited. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
